verdict.rationale: Asana documents a formal deprecation process with Asana-Enable/Asana-Disable headers, Asana-Change deprecation notices, migration plans, and dual old/new behavior periods during transitions, plus an official OpenAPI spec repo enabling versioned schema tracking. missing for 10: explicit semantic versioning scheme (e.g., v1/v2 URI versioning) and independent third-party confirmation that the deprecation policy is reliably honored in practice.
